outcome: Write or edit plain, natural prose that fits the reader and keeps the author's meaning and exact data.

research_receipts.claim: Plain writing starts from readers' real questions and needs.
research_receipts.limitations: A generic reading level does not replace knowledge of the actual reader.

research_receipts.claim: Test early, revise, and test again with real readers.
research_receipts.limitations: Model review is not reader testing.

research_receipts.claim: Complex text may need a simpler version.
research_receipts.limitations: WCAG's cited level is lower secondary, not grade 6.

research_receipts.claim: Communication can be reviewed with criteria beyond word choice.
research_receipts.limitations: The package claims no Index score without the full method.

research_receipts.claim: Quality judgments of AI slop link to relevance, coherence, repetition, and tone.
research_receipts.limitations: A word list or one model verdict cannot certify quality.

disconfirmation.question: Can a banned-word list prove prose is plain and natural?
disconfirmation.result: No. Slop judgments span several traits and vary between raters.
disconfirmation.disposition: Keep the word-list lint and the reader-fit review as separate gates.
